method: Review every first-parent change through the base head, including non-fix subjects. Split independently failing behaviors, merge iterative fixes of the same defect, retain identified CI/configuration/dependency/documentation/test-only defects conservatively, and do not count a new feature’s defensive tests as historical defects. Credit only source-and-assertion reviewed mappings; identify differential replay separately. All credited tests were introduced during the six-month window; later additions are explicitly retrospective. Expand dependency-report groups to their reported finding count without assuming unique CVE identities, and give those findings zero regression credit. This proves a lower bound, not an exact percentage of unique defects.
